meta.collection: うたのほし 歌詞アーカイブ (分割)

songs.title: オニガイル
songs.title_en: ONI GA IRU — Demons Among Us
songs.lyrics:
羨ましさが隠された　負目だらけの謙遜に
儚き現世見抜いた　鬼が笑い出した丑三つ

浮かび上がってる傷跡から痛み出した記憶たち
忘却の川に流した

ああ、なんであなたたちはそんなに
針だらけの山　渡り切って行ってしまうの
上から投げられる　石の硬さに
決めつけられているの？

沈められていた弱き者も
落ちていた石を拾う　投げて鬼となるジレンマ

ああ、なんであなたたちはそんなに
投げられた石を　軽く避けていってしまうの
何事も無いように　振り向きもしないで

ああ、なんで私たちはこんなに　
置いてかれること　怖くて仕方がないの？
笑い続けている　鬼たちの目が泣き出しそうな夜
songs.lyrics_en:
Envy hides beneath humility
So full of shame, of feeling less
Through this fleeting world, the demons see
And laugh in the dead of night

From scars that rise into the light
Old memories begin to ache
I let them drift
Down the river of forgetting

Ah, why do you all keep going
Across those mountains made of needles?
Do the stones thrown down from high above
Decide who you must be?

Even the weak, held down below
Pick up the stones beneath their feet
One throw—and turn to demons too
Caught in the same cruel bind

Ah, how can you so lightly
Dodge the stones and hurry on?
As though nothing ever happened
Without a backward glance

Ah, why are we so frightened
So afraid of being left behind?
Tonight, the demons keep on laughing
With eyes about to cry

songs.title: 船は進む
songs.lyrics:
Fu u fu …

流れ着いた　神話の岸辺に
朽ちかけていた大船

舵を切ってゆこう　僕たちの地図取り戻し
未踏の物語の続き　始める

行こう　ときめきと　浮かぶ船は進む
行こう　揺れながら　笑う声を乗せてく

閉ざされた記憶の中で　Fu u fu

舵を切ってゆこう　僕たちの手で見つけ出す
遠くの幻の楽園は　消えてく

行こう　愛しさと　守る命たちと
行こう　迷っても　ずっと光る星見て

探し出す　浮かぶ船は進む　
行こう　揺れながら　笑う声を聞かせて

Fu u fu …
songs.lyrics_en:
Fu u fu …

Washed ashore on the coast of myth
An old ship lay, worn by time

Let’s take the helm, reclaim the map we lost
Begin the next chapter, where no one’s ever been

Let’s go, with wonder in our hearts, the floating ship sails on
Let’s go, swaying as we sail, carrying our laughter

Within the memories locked away　Fu u fu …

Let’s take the helm, we’ll find the way ourselves
That distant paradise, a fading dream

Let’s go, with love, with all the lives we’ll keep safe
Let’s go, though we may lose our way, that star is shining still

We’ll find our way, the floating ship sails on
Let’s go, swaying as we sail, let me hear your laughter

Fu u fu …

songs.title: 太古再醒
songs.lyrics:
隠された宮の　土の中で覚醒める
古き御魂の音　石つたう

秋の空は　赤き炎を映す時

実を掠め盗った　虚な目が翳った
邪の嫉妬　偽りを呑んだ
糧を横取った　口威張って嗤った
驕り高ぶって　踏み躙って逃げた

蔓延っている　穢れを切って　
罪の根を摘み取って
熱く燃える　炎で焼いて
欺瞞さえ消し去ってゆく

赦しの前に燃える道を
照らして　照らして

夢奪い取って　老獪が貪った
守り歯向かった　健気さを刺した
力争って　邪魔だから消し去った
知恵で間違って　過ち隠した

潜みつづける　穢れを切って　
罪の根を摘み取って
熱く燃える　炎で焼いて
心に灯した火で
songs.lyrics_en:
Beneath the earth of a hidden shrine
Ancient spirits wake
Their echoes travel through the stone

When autumn skies reflect the crimson flames

You stole the fruit, your hollow eyes grew dim
Drank down the lies of bitter jealousy
You snatched our bread, then laughed in boastful pride
Trampled others down and ran away

Cut away the darkness spreading
Pluck the roots of wrongdoing
Burn it all in blazing fire
Till every veil of lies is gone

Light the burning path before forgiveness
Light the way, light the way

Cunning hands stole dreams and fed their greed
Pierced the brave who stood to guard what they held dear
You fought for power, erased those in your way
With clever minds, went wrong, then hid the wrong away

Cut away the darkness hiding
Pluck the roots of wrongdoing
Burn it all in blazing fire
With the flame we’ve kindled in our hearts

songs.title: ずっと未来から
songs.lyrics:
泣いてる時も忘れないでね
嬉しいことがまたやってくるよ
聞こえてるかい？誰かの声
信じてみて　それは未来の自分

子供の時に傘差しながら
足元ばかり見ていたあの時
水たまりが映していた自分の顔　
今も鏡に映る　一緒に

心で信じてる
大切なものばかり集めて
選びとった世界線から
聞こえてくる声は　「そうだよ」

笑顔の時は続かなくて
傷つく時もたまにはあるけど
歌ってるよ　今この時
時空を超えて　過去と未来をつなぐ

信じ続けるなら
続いてく道のずっと先に
信じていた自分の顔が笑っている
だから　

心でつながった
大切な人たちと話して
選びとった世界線から
聞こえてくる言葉は
「ありがとう」
そうだよ
愛だよ
songs.lyrics_en:
Even when you cry, don't you forget
Happy days will come around again
Can you hear someone calling you?
Trust that voice, it's your future self

Back when you were just a little child
Beneath your umbrella, looking down
Your face reflected in the rain
Still in the mirror now, together with you

Keep believing in your heart
Gather all the things you treasure most
From the future you have chosen
Comes a voice that says, "That's right"

Smiling days may not last forever
Sometimes you'll find yourself getting hurt
But I'm singing here, right now
Across all time, joining past and future

If you keep believing
Far beyond, along this winding road
The self you've always trusted is smiling there
And so

Speak with those you treasure
With the people joined to you by heart
From the future you have chosen
Come the words
"Thank you"
"That's right"
"It's love"

songs.title: 澄み渡る空のずっと向こう
songs.title_en: Far Beyond the Clear Blue Sky
songs.lyrics:
澄み渡る空の　ずっと向こうから
吹き渡る風に　言葉託しているの　ここで

突き刺すような　痛いニュースから
こぼれて落ちてく　嘆きのつぶて拾う
この手　痛みを知らず
震えた声が胸につかえても

祈る　精一杯　涙が出てきたって
揺れる声きっと神様は聞いているから
この小さなつぶやきも　ほら　
今ここで青い空の色味になって

もしも一つだけ願い事が叶うなら、嗚呼

澄み渡る空の　ずっと向こうから
吹き渡る風に　言葉託して贈る　
ここで　痛みを包む
震えた声が地面に落ちても

歌う　精一杯　不安ばかり感じても　
揺れる感情も私だけの色で咲いた花
弱さ見せてもいいから
今ここで風に吹かれて　生きる
嬉しさを抱く

そうさ　この小さな歌声も　ほら
今ここで青い星の響きになってゆく
songs.lyrics_en:
From far beyond the clear blue sky
A wandering wind comes blowing through
I give my words into its care
Here where I stand

From news that cuts so sharp and deep
I gather fallen fragments of grief
These hands have never known that pain
Though a trembling voice catches in my chest

I pray with all I have
Even when the tears begin to fall
I know that God is listening
To every tremble in my voice
Even this little whisper, see
Here and now becomes a shade of blue
Within the sky

If only one wish could come true, ah

From far beyond the clear blue sky
A wandering wind comes blowing through
I send my words upon its wings
Here where I stand
To hold the pain with tenderness
Even if my trembling voice falls to the ground

I sing with all I have
Even when my heart is filled with fear
These shifting feelings bloom into a flower
In colors only I can bring
It's all right to let my weakness show
Here and now, with the wind upon my face
I live
And hold the joy of being alive

Yes, even this small singing voice, see
Here and now becomes a part
Of the music of this blue world
